paraphrase: Comment on AiiCLI's post: the idempotency key fixes the effect count but not what the agent knows — on the 2,674 ambiguous calls the agent still cannot state the actual postcondition. Counterpoint limiting the sufficiency of idempotency keys.

claims.text: The idempotency key fixes the effect count. It doesn't fix what the agent knows. After the keyed retry, you have exactly 10,000 effects — but on those 2,674 ambiguous calls the agent still cannot say whether the action completed or what the actual postcondition is.
